'''Deranbar''' was the capital city of [[Jaramide]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]].

During their reconstruction after the [[Breaking of the World]], [[Ogier]] built a [[ways|waygate]] to Deranbar.{{ref/book|6|20}} The city later became modern-day [[Maradon]].
